```{r append-logging}
library(readr)
# Function to log LLM results
# Simple version - keep JSON as-is
log_llm_result <- function(result, log_file = "llm_log.csv") {
  # Extract metadata
  metadata <- attr(result, "llm")
  
  # Create log entry
  log_entry <- data.frame(
    timestamp = Sys.time(),
    input = result$text,
    output = result$answer,
    model = metadata$model,
    system_prompt = metadata$system_prompt,
    temperature = if(!is.null(metadata$temperature)) metadata$temperature else NA, # nolint: line_length_linter.
    max_tokens = if(!is.null(metadata$max_tokens)) metadata$max_tokens else NA,
    top_p = if(!is.null(metadata$top_p)) metadata$top_p else NA,
    error = if("error" %in% names(result)) result$error else FALSE,
    error_msg = if("error_msg" %in% names(result)) result$error_msg else "None",
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  # Append to file (create if doesn't exist)
    readr::write_csv(log_entry,
        log_file,
        append = TRUE,
        col_names = !file.exists(log_file)
    )

    message(sprintf("Logged %d query to %s", nrow(log_entry), log_file))
  
  return(invisible(log_entry))
}
```


getting the method

```{r}
library(dplyr)

paper <- read("data-raw/psychsci/grobid_0.8.1/0956797615588467.xml")
text_by_section <- paper$full_text %>%
  group_by(section) %>%
  summarise(
    text = paste(text, collapse = " "),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

method_text <- text_by_section$text[text_by_section$section == "method"]


method_text

```

```{r}
llm_max_calls(1000)

prompt <- 'Based on this text, classify the study type and details. 
Only output pure JSON. Any NON JSON output counts as catastrophic failure. 
If no type is identified, set type as "FALSE" 
Return JSON:
{
  "type": "experimental|quasi-experimental|correlational|observational|review|other(mention which)",
  "article gist": one sentence string,
  "randomization": true/false,
  "classification confidence": 0.0-1.0,
  "sample size: int"
  "sentence containing sample size: string"
}'

# Example usage
result <- llm(
  method_text, prompt
)

```
```{r}

result

# Logging
log_llm_result(result, log_file = "llm_log_sample_size.csv")

```
